release: Pulse 23 qualified collector source and test publication
scope: Collector infrastructure source and unit tests only

aggregate_algorithm.description: Sort selected bundle-relative paths lexicographically using forward slashes. For each path, hash the concatenation of its UTF-8 path byte length as an unsigned 8-byte big-endian integer, the UTF-8 path bytes, and the raw 32-byte SHA-256 digest of the file. Prefix the final lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 with sha256:.

runtime_requirements.ubuntu: Ubuntu under WSL with Python >= 3.10 and /bin/sh
runtime_requirements.cross_platform_launcher: Run qualification.py from Windows so it can invoke both PowerShell and WSL

license_and_provenance.provenance: Exact byte-for-byte copy of the independently qualified Pulse 23 collector infrastructure source and unit-test set. The discovery location is intentionally not disclosed.
license_and_provenance.license: No standalone license file accompanied the qualified set or the TRACKER root at publication time. This manifest does not create or expand license rights; users must obtain applicable rights from the publisher.

forbidden_content_attestation.statement: The bundle contains infrastructure source and unit tests only. It contains no diagnostic data artifacts and requires no private file to run.
